classificationDefinitions.ENFORCED: an executable artefact proves it (test, verifier script, migration, policy or machine-checked contract match) and, where a boundary is declared, a real call site invokes it
classificationDefinitions.DECLARED: a module, document or contract mentions it, but nothing executable proves it
classificationDefinitions.IMPLEMENTED_UNWIRED: implementation and tests exist, but the declared boundary patterns match nothing — the capability protects nothing yet

areas.area: Agent and tool actions fail closed or require review
areas.requirement: Undeployed/suspended agents, denied tools and dangerous tool categories are denied or routed to human review; acting-as-user requires explicit grant.

areas.area: Risk signals and sensitive operations escalate appropriately
areas.requirement: Risk levels derive from evidence signals, critical signals quarantine, and high/critical sensitive operations require human review.

areas.area: Security events and evidence are attributable and immutable
areas.requirement: Security events retain tenant/actor/evidence context, cannot be deleted, and evidence records are access-controlled.

areas.area: Alerts and security incidents follow ordered closure requirements
areas.requirement: Alerts and incidents transition through ordered states, require owners/evidence, and cannot close without resolution.

areas.area: Defense measures and recommends without owning enforcement
areas.requirement: Adversarial defense does not grant/revoke access, weaken controls or replace Phase 08/09 enforcement and trust authority.

areas.area: Live adversarial exercises, anomaly posture and hardening operations are wired
areas.requirement: Controlled exercises run with declared scope, findings persist with evidence, anomaly thresholds are governed, and hardening remains approval-gated.

limitations: Classification measures the presence of executable evidence, not the correctness or completeness of that evidence.
A DECLARED area is unfinished work, never a false claim — it is reported as such.
An IMPLEMENTED_UNWIRED area has a tested implementation that no boundary calls; it is reported, never counted as enforcement.
Evidence patterns are declared per phase in architecture/phase-acceptance/phase-<id>-*.json and must be reviewed when a phase is re-audited.
